Title: Azure SQL—Public preview updates for late April 2022

Body.Content:
Azure SQL—Public preview updates for late April 2022

In late April 2022, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • Azure SQL Database Hyperscale now supports point-in-time restore for up to 35 days
